Title: SkyeBrowse updates pricing with new tools for drone 3D mapping
Summary:
Here is a summary of the article in 2-3 sentences:

SkyeBrowse has updated its pricing structure for its drone 3D mapping platform to better cater to the needs of users. The company has introduced three new plans, each designed to suit the specific use cases of teams that capture 3D models with drones. This move is intended to provide more flexibility and affordability for users.

Title: DJI wants drone pilots to turn heritage sites into 3D flythroughs
Summary:
Here is a 2-3 sentence summary of the article for a busy reader:

DJI is launching a global competition to encourage drone pilots to document and preserve heritage sites using 3D mapping and flythrough videos. The World Heritage 3D Conservation Initiative challenges pilots to create detailed 3D models of natural and cultural sites, highlighting the potential for drones to play a role in conservation efforts. By capturing these sites in 3D, pilots can help preserve these sites for future generations.
